claims.statement: Regulation (EU) 2024/573 says non-hermetically sealed equipment charged with listed F-gases may be sold to an end user only where evidence shows installation by a certified undertaking.
Sellers must keep records of the equipment sold and certified undertaking that will install it for at least five years.

contrary_evidence: Merchants can perform manual certificate collection, and refrigerant transitions or growth in hermetically sealed products can shrink the gated category.

founder_fit: Unusually strong founder-channel fit through the parents' renewable installer company and a highly asynchronous merchant product. UNVALIDATED HYPOTHESIS: PLN 45000 supports a reversible single-wholesaler validation.
risks: Registry coverage or certificate revocation latency can yield false approvals.
The seller remains responsible; the product must not claim regulatory delegation.

structure.commercial_archetype: merchant authorisation clearinghouse for regulated equipment sales
structure.control_point: wholesale checkout release for non-hermetically sealed pre-charged equipment
structure.critical_dependency: authoritative installer-certificate status and legally acceptable seller record capture

thesis: Give HVAC and heat-pump wholesalers an embedded checkout gate that verifies the installer undertaking, binds its certificate evidence to the end-user order and preserves the seller's required record. A certificate-identity and fraud-resolution graph shared across opted-in merchants makes repeat checks faster and harder to spoof.
title: F-Gas Certified-Installer Checkout Gate
uncertainties: Machine-readable Polish and cross-border certificate sources
Order volume in the exact regulated category
Wholesaler appetite for a shared identity graph
